story.c00.b00.speaker: TEAL
story.c00.b00.text: Two taps. That's me. If you're hearing this, I missed a check-in, and you're sitting in my chair because nobody else wanted the paperwork.
story.c00.b00.spoken: Two taps. That's me. If you're hearing this, I missed a check-in, and you're sitting in my chair because nobody else wanted the paperwork.

story.c00.b01.speaker: SERA
story.c00.b01.text: He missed three. He told me once: one check-in is weather, two is trouble, three is worry. I've been worried since Tuesday.
story.c00.b01.spoken: He missed three. He told me once: one check-in is weather, two is trouble, three is worry. I've been worried since Tuesday.

story.c00.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c00.b02.text: Sparrow. You fly the pattern too low and too fast, and I never fixed it, because it's the only thing you do without asking permission.
story.c00.b02.spoken: Sparrow. You fly the pattern too low and too fast, and I never fixed it, because it's the only thing you do without asking permission.

story.c00.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c00.b03.text: Command calls it desertion. They made me say the word on the net. I said it. I'm not saying it again.
story.c00.b03.spoken: Command calls it desertion. They made me say the word on the net. I said it. I'm not saying it again.

story.c00.b04.speaker: TEAL
story.c00.b04.text: If I miss your checkout, fly the pattern anyway. The sky will still be there.
story.c00.b04.spoken: If I miss your checkout, fly the pattern anyway. The sky will still be there.

story.c00.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c00.b05.text: Three bandits on the rim and an empty chair. Fine. I'll fly the pattern.
story.c00.b05.spoken: Three bandits on the rim and an empty chair. Fine. I'll fly the pattern.

story.c01.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c01.b00.text: The bandits wore our markings. Our paint, our numbers. One of them was a tail I cleared for departure in March.
story.c01.b00.spoken: The bandits wore our markings. Our paint, our numbers. One of them was a tail I cleared for departure in March.

story.c01.b01.speaker: SERA
story.c01.b01.text: The quartermaster found a case under Teal's bunk. A coffee tin, twelve tapes, and a note: 'For Sera. Not for the net.'
story.c01.b01.spoken: The quartermaster found a case under Teal's bunk. A coffee tin, twelve tapes, and a note: 'For Sera. Not for the net.'

story.c01.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c01.b02.text: Keep these off the command net. Somebody up there is listening and signing things they shouldn't. If I go quiet, the case goes to Sera. Only Sera.
story.c01.b02.spoken: Keep these off the command net. Somebody up there is listening and signing things they shouldn't. If I go quiet, the case goes to Sera. Only Sera.

story.c01.b03.speaker: TEAL
story.c01.b03.text: There's a manifest in the tin. Aviation fuel, shipped as grain, to five quays on Iron Coast. Nobody ships grain in drums.
story.c01.b03.spoken: There's a manifest in the tin. Aviation fuel, shipped as grain, to five quays on Iron Coast. Nobody ships grain in drums.

story.c01.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c01.b04.text: Iron Coast is a hundred miles of our own shoreline. Whoever this is, they're not invading. They're already home.
story.c01.b04.spoken: Iron Coast is a hundred miles of our own shoreline. Whoever this is, they're not invading. They're already home.

story.c01.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c01.b05.text: Then I'll go and look at the quays myself.
story.c01.b05.spoken: Then I'll go and look at the quays myself.

story.c02.b00.speaker: TEAL
story.c02.b00.text: I came home through the western switchback. Not the pretty way. The way you take when you don't want to be seen coming home.
story.c02.b00.spoken: I came home through the western switchback. Not the pretty way. The way you take when you don't want to be seen coming home.

story.c02.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c02.b01.text: I dropped beacons on the way in. Low power, my own frequency. If anyone ever follows me, I wanted it to be someone who knew the song.
story.c02.b01.spoken: I dropped beacons on the way in. Low power, my own frequency. If anyone ever follows me, I wanted it to be someone who knew the song.

story.c02.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c02.b02.text: Recovery wanted to walk the canyon for him. Command said no: there are scouts in the rocks, and recovery teams don't carry missiles.
story.c02.b02.spoken: Recovery wanted to walk the canyon for him. Command said no: there are scouts in the rocks, and recovery teams don't carry missiles.

story.c02.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c02.b03.text: He used to tune that canyon on Sundays. Said it was the only place the tower couldn't talk to him.
story.c02.b03.spoken: He used to tune that canyon on Sundays. Said it was the only place the tower couldn't talk to him.

story.c02.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c02.b04.text: Recovery can reach his receiver if you mark it and stay on their frequency. Finding him is work we can do together.
story.c02.b04.spoken: Recovery can reach his receiver if you mark it and stay on their frequency. Finding him is work we can do together.

story.c02.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c02.b05.text: Then that's where he went when he had something to say.
story.c02.b05.spoken: Then that's where he went when he had something to say.

story.c03.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c03.b00.text: Recovery got into the lower switchback. They found his receiver in the rocks. Cracked case, memory intact. He put it where it would be found.
story.c03.b00.spoken: Recovery got into the lower switchback. They found his receiver in the rocks. Cracked case, memory intact. He put it where it would be found.

story.c03.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c03.b01.text: There's a radar inside our own training box. Dug into the bowl north of the pass. Nobody signed for it. I checked the ledger three times.
story.c03.b01.spoken: There's a radar inside our own training box. Dug into the bowl north of the pass. Nobody signed for it. I checked the ledger three times.

story.c03.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c03.b02.text: Somebody wanted to watch trainees. Not the sky. Trainees. Think about why you'd want to know when the kids fly.
story.c03.b02.spoken: Somebody wanted to watch trainees. Not the sky. Trainees. Think about why you'd want to know when the kids fly.

story.c03.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c03.b03.text: If it's real, it's been watching every pattern you've flown for a year. Command wants it gone quietly. I want it photographed first.
story.c03.b03.spoken: If it's real, it's been watching every pattern you've flown for a year. Command wants it gone quietly. I want it photographed first.

story.c03.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c03.b04.text: The staff list has to reach Varda after the strike. An erased radar can still leave a record nobody can explain away.
story.c03.b04.spoken: The staff list has to reach Varda after the strike. An erased radar can still leave a record nobody can explain away.

story.c03.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c03.b05.text: If I just blow it up, it's a rumour. If I look at it first, it's a crime.
story.c03.b05.spoken: If I just blow it up, it's a rumour. If I look at it first, it's a crime.

story.c04.b00.speaker: TEAL
story.c04.b00.text: The Teklan farmers let me hide a tape in a seed tin. The old woman asked my name, not my rank. Nobody at Varda has asked my name in ten years.
story.c04.b00.spoken: The Teklan farmers let me hide a tape in a seed tin. The old woman asked my name, not my rank. Nobody at Varda has asked my name in ten years.

story.c04.b01.speaker: SERA
story.c04.b01.text: The radar's memory names that orchard. Three days later somebody ordered it evacuated. Now there are patrols firing on the evacuation trucks.
story.c04.b01.spoken: The radar's memory names that orchard. Three days later somebody ordered it evacuated. Now there are patrols firing on the evacuation trucks.

story.c04.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c04.b02.text: They're not shooting at farmers. They're shooting at a seed tin. That's how badly someone wants Teal's tape back.
story.c04.b02.spoken: They're not shooting at farmers. They're shooting at a seed tin. That's how badly someone wants Teal's tape back.

story.c04.b03.speaker: RUSK
story.c04.b03.text: ...three officers at Varda are being reassigned tonight. Their names are already off the roster. Nobody will ask. Nobody ever asks.
story.c04.b03.spoken: ...three officers at Varda are being reassigned tonight. Their names are already off the roster. Nobody will ask. Nobody ever asks.

story.c04.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c04.b04.text: Count the trucks again at the road. I want names for the beds at Varda, not a report that says most of them got out.
story.c04.b04.spoken: Count the trucks again at the road. I want names for the beds at Varda, not a report that says most of them got out.

story.c04.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c04.b05.text: Those trucks are carrying somebody who asked his name. They get out.
story.c04.b05.spoken: Those trucks are carrying somebody who asked his name. They get out.

story.c05.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c05.b00.text: The convoy made it. The old woman's granddaughter drove the lead truck. She marked three silos on the map with her thumb. 'Those smell wrong.'
story.c05.b00.spoken: The convoy made it. The old woman's granddaughter drove the lead truck. She marked three silos on the map with her thumb. 'Those smell wrong.'

story.c05.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c05.b01.text: Three tanks under grain permits. Aviation fuel. The farmers know the difference, they just can't prove it. A fuel ledger would prove it.
story.c05.b01.spoken: Three tanks under grain permits. Aviation fuel. The farmers know the difference, they just can't prove it. A fuel ledger would prove it.

story.c05.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c05.b02.text: Sparrow. Every unmarked silo in that valley is somebody's winter. Don't be the one who makes them hungry to make a point.
story.c05.b02.spoken: Sparrow. Every unmarked silo in that valley is somebody's winter. Don't be the one who makes them hungry to make a point.

story.c05.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c05.b03.text: He wrote that one for you. He never wrote anything for me. I'm choosing not to be hurt by that today.
story.c05.b03.spoken: He wrote that one for you. He never wrote anything for me. I'm choosing not to be hurt by that today.

story.c05.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c05.b04.text: The farm crew can read the ledger over your radio once the patrol is gone. Fuel burns. The names on the page must survive it.
story.c05.b04.spoken: The farm crew can read the ledger over your radio once the patrol is gone. Fuel burns. The names on the page must survive it.

story.c05.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c05.b05.text: Three thumbprints. Three fires. Nothing else.
story.c05.b05.spoken: Three thumbprints. Three fires. Nothing else.

story.c06.b00.speaker: TEAL
story.c06.b00.text: One courier flies the frequency book through the dust pass every evening. Same time, same whine in the engine. Somebody should fix that bearing.
story.c06.b00.spoken: One courier flies the frequency book through the dust pass every evening. Same time, same whine in the engine. Somebody should fix that bearing.

story.c06.b01.speaker: SERA
story.c06.b01.text: We pulled his escort code out of the silo radios. Five fighters hide in the dust front with him. They'd rather lose him than drop what he carries.
story.c06.b01.spoken: We pulled his escort code out of the silo radios. Five fighters hide in the dust front with him. They'd rather lose him than drop what he carries.

story.c06.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c06.b02.text: If the book is real, every relay on the plateau is in it. Every forged voice. Every name.
story.c06.b02.spoken: If the book is real, every relay on the plateau is in it. Every forged voice. Every name.

story.c06.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c06.b03.text: Scan the clearings before you chase. Then read me the packet on a clean channel; I want its words before command can rewrite them.
story.c06.b03.spoken: Scan the clearings before you chase. Then read me the packet on a clean channel; I want its words before command can rewrite them.

story.c06.b04.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c06.b04.text: Then I'd like to read it.
story.c06.b04.spoken: Then I'd like to read it.

story.c07.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c07.b00.text: Not a frequency book. Tomorrow's orders. Varda tower 'compromised', the challenge code changed, my crew 'relieved' at 0400.
story.c07.b00.spoken: Not a frequency book. Tomorrow's orders. Varda tower 'compromised', the challenge code changed, my crew 'relieved' at oh-four-hundred.

story.c07.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c07.b01.text: If they ever call our tower compromised, check who changed the challenge code. The tower doesn't go bad. The code does.
story.c07.b01.spoken: If they ever call our tower compromised, check who changed the challenge code. The tower doesn't go bad. The code does.

story.c07.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c07.b02.text: They've moved it up. They know we have the packet. Two flights are inbound and my crew is in the tower with a soldering iron and the old code on a napkin.
story.c07.b02.spoken: They've moved it up. They know we have the packet. Two flights are inbound and my crew is in the tower with a soldering iron and the old code on a napkin.

story.c07.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c07.b03.text: I'm staying in the tower. In case you were wondering. I'm not leaving my chair for them.
story.c07.b03.spoken: I'm staying in the tower. In case you were wondering. I'm not leaving my chair for them.

story.c07.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c07.b04.text: Spotters are using the apron smoke. Mark the dishes first, and stay until our own flights answer the restored tower code.
story.c07.b04.spoken: Spotters are using the apron smoke. Mark the dishes first, and stay until our own flights answer the restored tower code.

story.c07.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c07.b05.text: Keep the lights on, Sera. I'll keep the sky.
story.c07.b05.spoken: Keep the lights on, Sera. I'll keep the sky.

story.c08.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c08.b00.text: The tower is ours again. The old code went out at 0353 and three flights turned around on hearing it. One didn't.
story.c08.b00.spoken: The tower is ours again. The old code went out at oh-three-fifty-three and three flights turned around on hearing it. One didn't.

story.c08.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c08.b01.text: Vulture Lead followed me into the pass. He wasn't chasing a deserter. You don't chase deserters at night with your lights off. He was erasing a witness.
story.c08.b01.spoken: Vulture Lead followed me into the pass. He wasn't chasing a deserter. You don't chase deserters at night with your lights off. He was erasing a witness.

story.c08.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c08.b02.text: He talks on the guard channel when he's hunting. Likes you to know. Don't answer him. Let the canyon answer.
story.c08.b02.spoken: He talks on the guard channel when he's hunting. Likes you to know. Don't answer him. Let the canyon answer.

story.c08.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c08.b03.text: He's searching the night approach for you now. Same lights off. Same voice. He thinks he's finishing a job.
story.c08.b03.spoken: He's searching the night approach for you now. Same lights off. Same voice. He thinks he's finishing a job.

story.c08.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c08.b04.text: He carries a recorder. Mark where it falls. Recovery should come home with more than another empty aircraft.
story.c08.b04.spoken: He carries a recorder. Mark where it falls. Recovery should come home with more than another empty aircraft.

story.c09.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c09.b00.text: Vulture Lead is down. His recorder survived. He carried relayed 'emergency orders', dozens, every one signed by a governor who's been dead since spring.
story.c09.b00.spoken: Vulture Lead is down. His recorder survived. He carried relayed 'emergency orders', dozens, every one signed by a governor who's been dead since spring.

story.c09.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c09.b01.text: Kiro talks to Lira. Lira talks to Merel. Merel talks to the harbours. Break one link and listen to who screams.
story.c09.b01.spoken: Kiro talks to Lira. Lira talks to Merel. Merel talks to the harbours. Break one link and listen to who screams.

story.c09.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c09.b02.text: Kiro keeps an archive. Every forged order, filed, because forgers are vain. It's the only honest thing on the plateau.
story.c09.b02.spoken: Kiro keeps an archive. Every forged order, filed, because forgers are vain. It's the only honest thing on the plateau.

story.c09.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c09.b03.text: I wiped his name off my board this morning. Then I wrote it back. I'm not ready to decide what he is.
story.c09.b03.spoken: I wiped his name off my board this morning. Then I wrote it back. I'm not ready to decide what he is.

story.c09.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c09.b04.text: Copy the archive before cutting Kiro. If a hidden radar answers, listen to its command channel until we can find it.
story.c09.b04.spoken: Copy the archive before cutting Kiro. If a hidden radar answers, listen to its command channel until we can find it.

story.c09.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c09.b05.text: I'd like to know what he saw.
story.c09.b05.spoken: I'd like to know what he saw.

story.c10.b00.speaker: RUSK
story.c10.b00.text: Declare the emergency first. Find the reason after. In a year, nobody has asked me for the reason.
story.c10.b00.spoken: Declare the emergency first. Find the reason after. In a year, nobody has asked me for the reason.

story.c10.b01.speaker: SERA
story.c10.b01.text: Kiro's archive survived. We have his signing key. But a key alone is a rumour. We need two more stations' logs with the same signature.
story.c10.b01.spoken: Kiro's archive survived. We have his signing key. But a key alone is a rumour. We need two more stations' logs with the same signature.

story.c10.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c10.b02.text: Lira and Merel sit on opposite ridges and hate each other's weather. Lira lies, Merel repeats her. The west ridge still hears the farms.
story.c10.b02.spoken: Lira and Merel sit on opposite ridges and hate each other's weather. Lira lies, Merel repeats her. The west ridge still hears the farms.

story.c10.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c10.b03.text: Three logs, one signature. If his words go out from the west ridge, they reach the people who hid him.
story.c10.b03.spoken: Three logs, one signature. If his words go out from the west ridge, they reach the people who hid him.

story.c10.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c10.b04.text: The north farm road has beacons the farmers maintain themselves. If another dish wakes up, that is how you reach it.
story.c10.b04.spoken: The north farm road has beacons the farmers maintain themselves. If another dish wakes up, that is how you reach it.

story.c10.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c10.b05.text: His own words, in his own voice, on their own relay. He'd have liked that.
story.c10.b05.spoken: His own words, in his own voice, on their own relay. He'd have liked that.

story.c11.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c11.b00.text: Your packet reached the farms. The old woman heard it in her kitchen. She says Teal sounded tired. She says he always sounded tired.
story.c11.b00.spoken: Your packet reached the farms. The old woman heard it in her kitchen. She says Teal sounded tired. She says he always sounded tired.

story.c11.b01.speaker: SERA
story.c11.b01.text: A loyalist crew has one mobile transmitter on a flatbed. It's the only voice on the plateau that isn't his. They're driving it into the refugee corridor.
story.c11.b01.spoken: A loyalist crew has one mobile transmitter on a flatbed. It's the only voice on the plateau that isn't his. They're driving it into the refugee corridor.

story.c11.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c11.b02.text: A transmitter on wheels is harder to silence than a voice in a tower. Harder to protect, too. Somebody will have to fly very close to a very slow truck.
story.c11.b02.spoken: A transmitter on wheels is harder to silence than a voice in a tower. Harder to protect, too. Somebody will have to fly very close to a very slow truck.

story.c11.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c11.b03.text: If the truck hears a different order, stop it at the fork. Check the mill road, test its new link and bring the relief crew in.
story.c11.b03.spoken: If the truck hears a different order, stop it at the fork. Check the mill road, test its new link and bring the relief crew in.

story.c11.b04.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c11.b04.text: Slow truck. Fast jet. I've done worse maths.
story.c11.b04.spoken: Slow truck. Fast jet. I've done worse maths.

story.c12.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c12.b00.text: The transmitter is through. Its first reply named four fuel silos and a relay on a 'farm' with a rail siding and no animals.
story.c12.b00.spoken: The transmitter is through. Its first reply named four fuel silos and a relay on a 'farm' with a rail siding and no animals.

story.c12.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c12.b01.text: They call it a farm because a fuel ledger would show the number of aircraft. The silos with no dust on the ladders. Those are the ones.
story.c12.b01.spoken: They call it a farm because a fuel ledger would show the number of aircraft. The silos with no dust on the ladders. Those are the ones.

story.c12.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c12.b02.text: There are real houses in that yard. Families who work the siding. I need you to come home with the right number of fires.
story.c12.b02.spoken: There are real houses in that yard. Families who work the siding. I need you to come home with the right number of fires.

story.c12.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c12.b03.text: The rail crew can copy the fuel ledger while you fly. Stay for their handoff. A burning tank cannot testify, but its ledger can.
story.c12.b03.spoken: The rail crew can copy the fuel ledger while you fly. Stay for their handoff. A burning tank cannot testify, but its ledger can.

story.c12.b04.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c12.b04.text: Four tanks and a dish. I can count to five.
story.c12.b04.spoken: Four tanks and a dish. I can count to five.

story.c13.b00.speaker: TEAL
story.c13.b00.text: There's a saddle where all three arrays can hear you at once. Go and say something true there. Nobody's said anything true on that frequency in a long time.
story.c13.b00.spoken: There's a saddle where all three arrays can hear you at once. Go and say something true there. Nobody's said anything true on that frequency in a long time.

story.c13.b01.speaker: SERA
story.c13.b01.text: The staging raid exposed a command frequency. It only reaches the saddle, and the antennas up there are his.
story.c13.b01.spoken: The staging raid exposed a command frequency. It only reaches the saddle, and the antennas up there are his.

story.c13.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c13.b02.text: Teal flew that saddle on his checkride. Vulture Two signed the card. I pulled it last night. The handwriting matches the forged orders.
story.c13.b02.spoken: Teal flew that saddle on his checkride. Vulture Two signed the card. I pulled it last night. The handwriting matches the forged orders.

story.c13.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c13.b03.text: A truck with a dish can replace a dead antenna. Look along the saddle road before we call the chain silent.
story.c13.b03.spoken: A truck with a dish can replace a dead antenna. Look along the saddle road before we call the chain silent.

story.c13.b04.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c13.b04.text: Then I'll fly his checkride for him. Properly, this time.
story.c13.b04.spoken: Then I'll fly his checkride for him. Properly, this time.

story.c14.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c14.b00.text: Three stations, one signature. The mobile crew has it on tape with the real governor's death certificate read over the top. It runs thirty-five seconds.
story.c14.b00.spoken: Three stations, one signature. The mobile crew has it on tape with the real governor's death certificate read over the top. It runs thirty-five seconds.

story.c14.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c14.b01.text: A clear signal needs time. Don't give them a hero. Give them thirty-five seconds and a hero is beside the point.
story.c14.b01.spoken: A clear signal needs time. Don't give them a hero. Give them thirty-five seconds and a hero is beside the point.

story.c14.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c14.b02.text: He recorded that two weeks before he vanished. Thirty-five seconds. He'd already timed it. He knew exactly what this would take.
story.c14.b02.spoken: He recorded that two weeks before he vanished. Thirty-five seconds. He'd already timed it. He knew exactly what this would take.

story.c14.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c14.b03.text: When the garrisons answer, follow their beacons and look for parked aircraft. A reply on the radio is not yet a promise kept.
story.c14.b03.spoken: When the garrisons answer, follow their beacons and look for parked aircraft. A reply on the radio is not yet a promise kept.

story.c14.b04.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c14.b04.text: Thirty-five seconds. Nobody jams me for thirty-five seconds.
story.c14.b04.spoken: Thirty-five seconds. Nobody jams me for thirty-five seconds.

story.c15.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c15.b00.text: Three garrisons heard it. Two stood down. And then the Marshal answered.
story.c15.b00.spoken: Three garrisons heard it. Two stood down. And then the Marshal answered.

story.c15.b01.speaker: RUSK
story.c15.b01.text: Varda Rim has broadcast enemy propaganda. It is a hostile station. The Teklan orchard sheltered the source. There will be no further warnings.
story.c15.b01.spoken: Varda Rim has broadcast enemy propaganda. It is a hostile station. The Teklan orchard sheltered the source. There will be no further warnings.

story.c15.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c15.b02.text: The orchard burned at noon. The old woman is alive. Her granddaughter is alive. The seed tin is ash. That's my report, and I hate it.
story.c15.b02.spoken: The orchard burned at noon. The old woman is alive. Her granddaughter is alive. The seed tin is ash. That's my report, and I hate it.

story.c15.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c15.b03.text: I asked you to broadcast. I'd ask again. I need you to know that I'd ask again.
story.c15.b03.spoken: I asked you to broadcast. I'd ask again. I need you to know that I'd ask again.

story.c15.b04.speaker: TEAL
story.c15.b04.text: Storms ground frightened people. They don't ground orders, or fuel, or the people who own them. When the weather's bad, that's when they move.
story.c15.b04.spoken: Storms ground frightened people. They don't ground orders, or fuel, or the people who own them. When the weather's bad, that's when they move.

story.c15.b05.speaker: SERA
story.c15.b05.text: Rain hides the last fuel markings. Look first. Then stay to copy the relay's final traffic while the farm crew gets clear.
story.c15.b05.spoken: Rain hides the last fuel markings. Look first. Then stay to copy the relay's final traffic while the farm crew gets clear.

story.c15.b06.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c15.b06.text: Then he's moving now, under the weather. And I'm going to be under it with him.
story.c15.b06.spoken: Then he's moving now, under the weather. And I'm going to be under it with him.

story.c16.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c16.b00.text: His plateau fuel is gone. One relay still talks: the crown station, under the aurora. It only transmits at night.
story.c16.b00.spoken: His plateau fuel is gone. One relay still talks: the crown station, under the aurora. It only transmits at night.

story.c16.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c16.b01.text: At the crown station I left the order that started all of this. The first one. With his real signature, before he learned to use dead men's names.
story.c16.b01.spoken: At the crown station I left the order that started all of this. The first one. With his real signature, before he learned to use dead men's names.

story.c16.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c16.b02.text: I didn't take it with me. I didn't trust myself to get home. I trusted the dish.
story.c16.b02.spoken: I didn't take it with me. I didn't trust myself to get home. I trusted the dish.

story.c16.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c16.b03.text: He didn't trust himself to get home. He said it out loud, to a tape, and flew anyway. I keep rewinding that part.
story.c16.b03.spoken: He didn't trust himself to get home. He said it out loud, to a tape, and flew anyway. I keep rewinding that part.

story.c16.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c16.b04.text: If the archive jams, look under the array. We bring home the whole signature this time, even if we have to receive it twice.
story.c16.b04.spoken: If the archive jams, look under the array. We bring home the whole signature this time, even if we have to receive it twice.

story.c16.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c16.b05.text: He trusted the dish. I can do that much.
story.c16.b05.spoken: He trusted the dish. I can do that much.

story.c17.b00.speaker: LOG
story.c17.b00.text: ARCHIVE RECOVERED. ORDER 0001. 'Declare regional emergency. Suspend parliament. Assume air command.' Signed: RUSK, AIR MARSHAL.
story.c17.b00.spoken: Archive recovered. Order zero-zero-zero-one. Declare regional emergency. Suspend parliament. Assume air command. Signed: Rusk, Air Marshal.

story.c17.b01.speaker: SERA
story.c17.b01.text: Rusk. He gave the speech at Teal's wing ceremony. He told us the sky belongs to whoever is willing to be up in it.
story.c17.b01.spoken: Rusk. He gave the speech at Teal's wing ceremony. He told us the sky belongs to whoever is willing to be up in it.

story.c17.b02.speaker: VULTURE TWO
story.c17.b02.text: Varda trainee, this is Vulture Two. I taught your instructor to fly. I know what he'd try from that ridge. Turn home. Nobody has to watch.
story.c17.b02.spoken: Varda trainee, this is Vulture Two. I taught your instructor to fly. I know what he'd try from that ridge. Turn home. Nobody has to watch.

story.c17.b03.speaker: TEAL
story.c17.b03.text: Vulture Two taught me that an order is not the same as a duty. Then he forgot. If you meet him, remind him. Loudly.
story.c17.b03.spoken: Vulture Two taught me that an order is not the same as a duty. Then he forgot. If you meet him, remind him. Loudly.

story.c17.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c17.b04.text: He's challenged your call sign from the ridge. Searchlights. He wants you to climb into them. He wants to see your face.
story.c17.b04.spoken: He's challenged your call sign from the ridge. Searchlights. He wants you to climb into them. He wants to see your face.

story.c17.b05.speaker: SERA
story.c17.b05.text: Mark a ridge pickup site before you meet him. If he ejects, the marines need time; the coast needs his testimony after that.
story.c17.b05.spoken: Mark a ridge pickup site before you meet him. If he ejects, the marines need time; the coast needs his testimony after that.

story.c18.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c18.b00.text: Vulture Two is down. He ejected. Marines lifted him off the ridge. He asked if you were Teal's. I said yes.
story.c18.b00.spoken: Vulture Two is down. He ejected. Marines lifted him off the ridge. He asked if you were Teal's. I said yes.

story.c18.b01.speaker: VULTURE TWO
story.c18.b01.text: He was the best I ever signed off. Tell the kid the handwriting was mine. All of it. I'm done lying to pilots.
story.c18.b01.spoken: He was the best I ever signed off. Tell the kid the handwriting was mine. All of it. I'm done lying to pilots.

story.c18.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c18.b02.text: On the coast, look at what the cranes unload. The uniforms tell you nothing. The crates do.
story.c18.b02.spoken: On the coast, look at what the cranes unload. The uniforms tell you nothing. The crates do.

story.c18.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c18.b03.text: Three warehouses on the military quays, two blocks from a fish market. Rusk put his war where he knew we'd hesitate.
story.c18.b03.spoken: Three warehouses on the military quays, two blocks from a fish market. Rusk put his war where he knew we'd hesitate.

story.c18.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c18.b04.text: Workers are still on those quays. Trace their launch a clear lane and stay for the rescue count after the stores burn.
story.c18.b04.spoken: Workers are still on those quays. Trace their launch a clear lane and stay for the rescue count after the stores burn.

story.c18.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c18.b05.text: He's right. I'll hesitate. Then I'll aim.
story.c18.b05.spoken: He's right. I'll hesitate. Then I'll aim.

story.c19.b00.speaker: TEAL
story.c19.b00.text: I made a paper copy. Radios get jammed. Ink still travels in a boat. It's in the harbour master's safe, and she doesn't like the Marshal either.
story.c19.b00.spoken: I made a paper copy. Radios get jammed. Ink still travels in a boat. It's in the harbour master's safe, and she doesn't like the Marshal either.

story.c19.b01.speaker: SERA
story.c19.b01.text: The harbour stores are gone. The harbour master has the copy on a courier launch. The eastern wing has the harbour mouth sealed.
story.c19.b01.spoken: The harbour stores are gone. The harbour master has the copy on a courier launch. The eastern wing has the harbour mouth sealed.

story.c19.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c19.b02.text: Everything we have is on that boat. The archive, the signatures, his tapes. If it sinks, Teal is a deserter forever.
story.c19.b02.spoken: Everything we have is on that boat. The archive, the signatures, his tapes. If it sinks, Teal is a deserter forever.

story.c19.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c19.b03.text: Check the exit before the launch moves. Then stay until the patrol boat confirms the case has changed hands at sea.
story.c19.b03.spoken: Check the exit before the launch moves. Then stay until the patrol boat confirms the case has changed hands at sea.

story.c20.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c20.b00.text: The launch is clear. Marines have the evidence. And the city still hears nothing but him.
story.c20.b00.spoken: The launch is clear. Marines have the evidence. And the city still hears nothing but him.

story.c20.b01.speaker: RUSK
story.c20.b01.text: Citizens. Parliament has fled. Rebel aircraft are over the harbour. Stay inside. Trust the lights. Trust my voice.
story.c20.b01.spoken: Citizens. Parliament has fled. Rebel aircraft are over the harbour. Stay inside. Trust the lights. Trust my voice.

story.c20.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c20.b02.text: One tower, one voice, one emergency on repeat. He didn't build it to tell anyone anything. He built it so nothing else gets in.
story.c20.b02.spoken: One tower, one voice, one emergency on repeat. He didn't build it to tell anyone anything. He built it so nothing else gets in.

story.c20.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c20.b03.text: The broadcast relay sits in a block of apartments. He chose that too. The canal is the only dark line through the city.
story.c20.b03.spoken: The broadcast relay sits in a block of apartments. He chose that too. The canal is the only dark line through the city.

story.c20.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c20.b04.text: Find the dish above the apartments before firing. Our repair crew is waiting in a launch to bring the district back afterwards.
story.c20.b04.spoken: Find the dish above the apartments before firing. Our repair crew is waiting in a launch to bring the district back afterwards.

story.c20.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c20.b05.text: Everyone in those apartments has been listening to him for a year. I'd like to give them some quiet.
story.c20.b05.spoken: Everyone in those apartments has been listening to him for a year. I'd like to give them some quiet.

story.c21.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c21.b00.text: The city heard silence last night. First time since spring. People opened their windows. Then the fog came in and he started fuelling.
story.c21.b00.spoken: The city heard silence last night. First time since spring. People opened their windows. Then the fog came in and he started fuelling.

story.c21.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c21.b01.text: The reserve fuel has five piers. Each one has a civilian permit, and every permit has the same signature. He never learned a second name.
story.c21.b01.spoken: The reserve fuel has five piers. Each one has a civilian permit, and every permit has the same signature. He never learned a second name.

story.c21.b02.speaker: RUSK
story.c21.b02.text: Trainee. I knew Teal. He flew my wing the winter the coast starved while parliament debated. He had talent too. Ask the canyon how far it got him.
story.c21.b02.spoken: Trainee. I knew Teal. He flew my wing the winter the coast starved while parliament debated. He had talent too. Ask the canyon how far it got him.

story.c21.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c21.b03.text: That's the first time he's used his own name. He wants you to know he's a person. Don't let him.
story.c21.b03.spoken: That's the first time he's used his own name. He wants you to know he's a person. Don't let him.

story.c21.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c21.b04.text: An inspection launch will follow you through the fog. Let its crew check the hoses, then show us the last two piers are dry.
story.c21.b04.spoken: An inspection launch will follow you through the fog. Let its crew check the hoses, then show us the last two piers are dry.

story.c21.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c21.b05.text: He flew your wing. Then you hunted him at night with your lights off. I'll remember both.
story.c21.b05.spoken: He flew your wing. Then you hunted him at night with your lights off. I'll remember both.

story.c22.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c22.b00.text: His convoy can't refuel. Three loyalist frigates have ringed the offshore platform. The command frigate carries a green beacon and most of our hope.
story.c22.b00.spoken: His convoy can't refuel. Three loyalist frigates have ringed the offshore platform. The command frigate carries a green beacon and most of our hope.

story.c22.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c22.b01.text: If I don't get home, leave the lane open for the next one. That's the job. There isn't a second part.
story.c22.b01.spoken: If I don't get home, leave the lane open for the next one. That's the job. There isn't a second part.

story.c22.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c22.b02.text: The frigate captain was at his wing ceremony too. Half this coast was. Rusk forgot that we all remember.
story.c22.b02.spoken: The frigate captain was at his wing ceremony too. Half this coast was. Rusk forgot that we all remember.

story.c22.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c22.b03.text: Check the last gap and cover the inspection launch across it. The landing force is waiting for a ring we have actually checked.
story.c22.b03.spoken: Check the last gap and cover the inspection launch across it. The landing force is waiting for a ring we have actually checked.

story.c22.b04.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c22.b04.text: Green beacon. I'll stay close enough to read it.
story.c22.b04.spoken: Green beacon. I'll stay close enough to read it.

story.c23.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c23.b00.text: The frigate held. He's pulling his flag off the platform tonight and leaving his reserves on the deck. He's running, and he's leaving the fuel behind.
story.c23.b00.spoken: The frigate held. He's pulling his flag off the platform tonight and leaving his reserves on the deck. He's running, and he's leaving the fuel behind.

story.c23.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c23.b01.text: Those stores were never on a defence map. You don't hide fuel at sea for a week. Only for a war.
story.c23.b01.spoken: Those stores were never on a defence map. You don't hide fuel at sea for a week. Only for a war.

story.c23.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c23.b02.text: Three stores on a trident of decks, under a storm he didn't order. There's no high approach left. Only the sea.
story.c23.b02.spoken: Three stores on a trident of decks, under a storm he didn't order. There's no high approach left. Only the sea.

story.c23.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c23.b03.text: A tanker is still on the platform, and workers are still on the deck. Stop the fuel leaving, then bring the rescue launch clear.
story.c23.b03.spoken: A tanker is still on the platform, and workers are still on the deck. Stop the fuel leaving, then bring the rescue launch clear.

story.c23.b04.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c23.b04.text: He said the canyon got Teal. Let's see what the sea does to him.
story.c23.b04.spoken: He said the canyon got Teal. Let's see what the sea does to him.

story.c24.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c24.b00.text: The platform is dry. Loyalist landing craft are off the city beach, waiting for first light. Parliament is coming home by boat.
story.c24.b00.spoken: The platform is dry. Loyalist landing craft are off the city beach, waiting for first light. Parliament is coming home by boat.

story.c24.b01.speaker: TEAL
story.c24.b01.text: Don't fly for the people giving orders. Fly for the people who have to live beneath them. The man on the net is weather.
story.c24.b01.spoken: Don't fly for the people giving orders. Fly for the people who have to live beneath them. The man on the net is weather.

story.c24.b02.speaker: SERA
story.c24.b02.text: He recorded that one at two in the morning. I can hear the hangar heater behind him. I could find that hangar in the dark by that sound.
story.c24.b02.spoken: He recorded that one at two in the morning. I can hear the hangar heater behind him. I could find that hangar in the dark by that sound.

story.c24.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c24.b03.text: Check both beach exits between the attacks. Stay on the landing channel until both squads answer from the streets.
story.c24.b03.spoken: Check both beach exits between the attacks. Stay on the landing channel until both squads answer from the streets.

story.c24.b04.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c24.b04.text: Beneath them. Right. The beach, then.
story.c24.b04.spoken: Beneath them. Right. The beach, then.

story.c25.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c25.b00.text: Recovery reached the upper pass this morning. They found his aircraft. They found him. He was in the seat. The recorder was still running.
story.c25.b00.spoken: Recovery reached the upper pass this morning. They found his aircraft. They found him. He was in the seat. The recorder was still running.

story.c25.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c25.b02.text: Two taps. Sparrow, it's me. Lead is on my tail and I'm out of altitude, so I'm going to stay in the pass a while. The seed trucks need ten minutes.
story.c25.b02.spoken: Two taps. Sparrow, it's me. Lead is on my tail and I'm out of altitude, so I'm going to stay in the pass a while. The seed trucks need ten minutes.

story.c25.b03.speaker: TEAL
story.c25.b03.text: I flew that order knowing the price. The tapes are so you never have to take my word for any of it. This part I'm choosing myself.
story.c25.b03.spoken: I flew that order knowing the price. The tapes are so you never have to take my word for any of it. This part I'm choosing myself.

story.c25.b04.speaker: TEAL
story.c25.b04.text: Fly the pattern too low and too fast. Nobody ever fixed it. Good. The sky will...
story.c25.b04.spoken: Fly the pattern too low and too fast. Nobody ever fixed it. Good. The sky will...

story.c25.b05.speaker: SERA
story.c25.b05.text: He bought those trucks ten minutes. Witnesses are boarding for parliament tonight. Keep their quay and launch safe so they can say what he did.
story.c25.b05.spoken: He bought those trucks ten minutes. Witnesses are boarding for parliament tonight. Keep their quay and launch safe so they can say what he did.

story.c25.b06.speaker: SERA
story.c25.b06.text: I've amended the record myself. 'Aircraft lost with pilot. KILLED, NOT DESERTED.' Command can court-martial the paperwork.
story.c25.b06.spoken: I've amended the record myself. Aircraft lost with pilot. Killed, not deserted. Command can court-martial the paperwork.

story.c25.b07.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c25.b07.text: Ten minutes. He bought ten minutes. I'm going to go and spend them.
story.c25.b07.spoken: Ten minutes. He bought ten minutes. I'm going to go and spend them.

story.c26.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c26.b00.text: The wing is broken. Your triangulation puts his last transmission above the parliament tower. He's alone up there with one relay and his own voice.
story.c26.b00.spoken: The wing is broken. Your triangulation puts his last transmission above the parliament tower. He's alone up there with one relay and his own voice.

story.c26.b01.speaker: RUSK
story.c26.b01.text: Trainee. Land, and I'll tell the city you were misled by a dead man. Fly, and you're the traitor in every history I write.
story.c26.b01.spoken: Trainee. Land, and I'll tell the city you were misled by a dead man. Fly, and you're the traitor in every history I write.

story.c26.b02.speaker: TEAL
story.c26.b02.text: When you have the truth, send it in your own voice. You don't have to sound like me. You never did.
story.c26.b02.spoken: When you have the truth, send it in your own voice. You don't have to sound like me. You never did.

story.c26.b03.speaker: SERA
story.c26.b03.text: I've got every harbour on the net. Every loyalist station is listening for one call sign. Not his. Yours.
story.c26.b03.spoken: I've got every harbour on the net. Every loyalist station is listening for one call sign. Not his. Yours.

story.c26.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c26.b04.text: Mark a clear road for Rusk before the duel. Then climb Teal's beacon line and stay on the air until every harbor hears you.
story.c26.b04.spoken: Mark a clear road for Rusk before the duel. Then climb Teal's beacon line and stay on the air until every harbor hears you.

story.c26.b05.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c26.b05.text: Marshal. I heard the tape. He didn't sound misled. He sounded like he was counting trucks.
story.c26.b05.spoken: Marshal. I heard the tape. He didn't sound misled. He sounded like he was counting trucks.

story.c26.b06.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c26.b06.text: Sera. Varda trainee, checking in. One of three. The other two are for after.
story.c26.b06.spoken: Sera. Varda trainee, checking in. One of three. The other two are for after.

story.c27.b00.speaker: SERA
story.c27.b00.text: He's down. His relay is dark. Every harbour on the coast is answering. You're on every receiver from the rim to the sea. Say it your way.
story.c27.b00.spoken: He's down. His relay is dark. Every harbour on the coast is answering. You're on every receiver from the rim to the sea. Say it your way.

story.c27.b01.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c27.b01.text: This is Varda trainee, transmitting in the clear. The Air Marshal is down. The emergency is over. It never started.
story.c27.b01.spoken: This is Varda trainee, transmitting in the clear. The Air Marshal is down. The emergency is over. It never started.

story.c27.b02.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c27.b02.text: The orders were forged. The names were dead men's. An orchard was burned for a seed tin. Teal flew the pass so the trucks could get out.
story.c27.b02.spoken: The orders were forged. The names were dead men's. An orchard was burned for a seed tin. Teal flew the pass so the trucks could get out.

story.c27.b03.speaker: TRAINEE
story.c27.b03.text: His name was Teal. He was not a deserter. Amend your records. For Teal. For the rim. We are coming home.
story.c27.b03.spoken: His name was Teal. He was not a deserter. Amend your records. For Teal. For the rim. We are coming home.

story.c27.b04.speaker: SERA
story.c27.b04.text: Varda trainee, Varda Control. Check-in received. Two of three. Come home and make the third in person.
story.c27.b04.spoken: Varda trainee, Varda Control. Check-in received. Two of three. Come home and make the third in person.

story.c27.b06.speaker: LOG
story.c27.b06.text: VARDA RIM ROSTER. TEAL: KILLED IN ACTION, NOT DESERTED. INSTRUCTOR'S CHAIR: FILLED.
story.c27.b06.spoken: Varda Rim roster. Teal: killed in action, not deserted. Instructor's chair: filled.

radio.m01.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m01.p1.beat.text: Turn, then pitch. Three seconds each. Feel how she answers.
radio.m01.p1.beat.spoken: Turn, then pitch. Three seconds each. Feel how she answers.

radio.m01.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m01.p2.beat.text: Cycle targets. Mark the practice radar.
radio.m01.p2.beat.spoken: Cycle targets. Mark the practice radar.

radio.m01.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m01.p3.beat.text: Nose on it. Hold the lock. Then fire.
radio.m01.p3.beat.spoken: Nose on it. Hold the lock. Then fire.

radio.m01.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m01.p4.beat.text: SERA: Good hit. Three bandits inbound. Keep them off the field.
radio.m01.p4.beat.spoken: Good hit. Three bandits inbound. Keep them off the field.

radio.m02.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m02.p1.beat.text: SERA: Three bandits over the harbor. Take them.
radio.m02.p1.beat.spoken: Three bandits over the harbor. Take them.

radio.m02.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m02.p2.beat.text: SERA: Five warehouses feed the raid. Burn them all.
radio.m02.p2.beat.spoken: Five warehouses feed the raid. Burn them all.

radio.m02.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m02.p3.beat.text: SERA: Their lead is armored. Make every shot count.
radio.m02.p3.beat.spoken: Their lead is armored. Make every shot count.

radio.m03.p1.beat.speaker: TEAL
radio.m03.p1.beat.text: TEAL (tape): Stay low on the switchback.

radio.m03.p1.chatter1.speaker: TEAL
radio.m03.p1.chatter1.text: TEAL (tape): Third beacon's the one I nearly missed.
radio.m03.p1.chatter1.spoken: Third beacon's the one I nearly missed.

radio.m03.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m03.p2.beat.text: SERA: Scan below the beacons. Recovery needs the receiver marked.
radio.m03.p2.beat.spoken: Scan below the beacons. Recovery needs the receiver marked.

radio.m03.p2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m03.p2.chatter1.text: SERA: Receiver echo below the second beacon. Keep scanning.
radio.m03.p2.chatter1.spoken: Receiver echo below the second beacon. Keep scanning.

radio.m03.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m03.p3.beat.text: SERA: Two scouts shadowing the rim. Clear the pair.
radio.m03.p3.beat.spoken: Two scouts shadowing the rim. Clear the pair.

radio.m03.p4.beat.speaker: TEAL
radio.m03.p4.beat.text: TEAL (tape): Under three-twenty along the river. Stay out of sight.
radio.m03.p4.beat.spoken: Under three-twenty along the river. Stay out of sight.

radio.m03.p4.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m03.p4.chatter1.text: SERA: Bravo flight is hunting the river. Last gate, then turn.
radio.m03.p4.chatter1.spoken: Bravo flight is hunting the river. Last gate, then turn.

radio.m03.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m03.p5.beat.text: SERA: Bravo flight breaking cover. Three, in two groups. Clear them.
radio.m03.p5.beat.spoken: Bravo flight breaking cover. Three, in two groups. Clear them.

radio.m03.p6.beat.speaker: RECOVERY
radio.m03.p6.beat.text: RECOVERY: We have your mark. Keep the link open while we reach it.
radio.m03.p6.beat.spoken: We have your mark. Keep the link open while we reach it.

radio.m03.p6.chatter1.speaker: RECOVERY
radio.m03.p6.chatter1.text: RECOVERY: Receiver in sight. We are climbing down now.
radio.m03.p6.chatter1.spoken: Receiver in sight. We are climbing down now.

radio.m04.p1.beat.speaker: BROADCAST
radio.m04.p1.beat.text: BROADCAST: All Varda units stand down. Authority: Air Marshal.
radio.m04.p1.beat.spoken: All Varda units stand down. Authority: Air Marshal.

radio.m04.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m04.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Stand down? Nobody at Varda issued that.
radio.m04.p1.chatter1.spoken: Stand down? Nobody at Varda issued that.

radio.m04.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m04.p2.beat.text: SERA: Proof's recorded. Now kill the radar.
radio.m04.p2.beat.spoken: Proof's recorded. Now kill the radar.

radio.m04.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m04.p3.beat.text: SERA: Evidence copied. Follow the service road clear.
radio.m04.p3.beat.spoken: Evidence copied. Follow the service road clear.

radio.m04.p3.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m04.p3.chatter1.text: SERA: Road is clear ahead. Keep to the beacon line.
radio.m04.p3.chatter1.spoken: Road is clear ahead. Keep to the beacon line.

radio.m04.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m04.p4.beat.text: SERA: They scrambled a flight. Five, in two groups. Hold the line.
radio.m04.p4.beat.spoken: They scrambled a flight. Five, in two groups. Hold the line.

radio.m04.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m04.p5.beat.text: SERA: Varda is copying the names. Hold the link.
radio.m04.p5.beat.spoken: Varda is copying the names. Hold the link.

radio.m04.p5.chatter1.speaker: TOWER
radio.m04.p5.chatter1.text: TOWER: First two names copied. Send the third.
radio.m04.p5.chatter1.spoken: First two names copied. Send the third.

radio.m05.p1.beat.speaker: FARMER
radio.m05.p1.beat.text: FARMER: Trucks rolling. Please stay with us.
radio.m05.p1.beat.spoken: Trucks rolling. Please stay with us.

radio.m05.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m05.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Second flight off the ridge. Turn back now.
radio.m05.p1.chatter1.spoken: Second flight off the ridge. Turn back now.

radio.m05.p1.chatter2.speaker: FARMER
radio.m05.p1.chatter2.text: FARMER: The road's in sight. Don't leave us yet.
radio.m05.p1.chatter2.spoken: The road's in sight. Don't leave us yet.

radio.m05.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m05.p2.beat.text: SERA: Trucks are clear. Their patrol leads are turning in. Three.
radio.m05.p2.beat.spoken: Trucks are clear. Their patrol leads are turning in. Three.

radio.m05.p3.beat.speaker: FARMER
radio.m05.p3.beat.text: FARMER: One truck lost its radio. Check both bends for stragglers.
radio.m05.p3.beat.spoken: One truck lost its radio. Check both bends for stragglers.

radio.m05.p3.chatter1.speaker: FARMER
radio.m05.p3.chatter1.text: FARMER: One bend clear. Check behind the orchard wall too.
radio.m05.p3.chatter1.spoken: One bend clear. Check behind the orchard wall too.

radio.m05.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m05.p4.beat.text: SERA: All trucks counted. Hold the link for the families' names.
radio.m05.p4.beat.spoken: All trucks counted. Hold the link for the families' names.

radio.m05.p4.chatter1.speaker: TOWER
radio.m05.p4.chatter1.text: TOWER: Names copied. Finding beds for the children now.
radio.m05.p4.chatter1.spoken: Names copied. Finding beds for the children now.

radio.m05.p5.beat.speaker: FARMER
radio.m05.p5.beat.text: FARMER: Seed tin is aboard. Follow our homeward beacons.
radio.m05.p5.beat.spoken: Seed tin is aboard. Follow our homeward beacons.

radio.m05.p5.chatter1.speaker: FARMER
radio.m05.p5.chatter1.text: FARMER: The lead truck sees your lights. Keep leading.
radio.m05.p5.chatter1.spoken: The lead truck sees your lights. Keep leading.

radio.m06.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m06.p1.beat.text: SERA: Follow the channel. The marked tanks sit at its end.
radio.m06.p1.beat.spoken: Follow the channel. The marked tanks sit at its end.

radio.m06.p1.chatter1.speaker: FARMER
radio.m06.p1.chatter1.text: FARMER: The unmarked roofs are ours. Please.
radio.m06.p1.chatter1.spoken: The unmarked roofs are ours. Please.

radio.m06.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m06.p2.beat.text: SERA: Low pass first. Mark the military silos, not the farmhouses.
radio.m06.p2.beat.spoken: Low pass first. Mark the military silos, not the farmhouses.

radio.m06.p2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m06.p2.chatter1.text: SERA: Fuel-grade grain in all three. The roofs are clean.
radio.m06.p2.chatter1.spoken: Fuel-grade grain in all three. The roofs are clean.

radio.m06.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m06.p3.beat.text: SERA: Marked silos only. That grain is fuel.
radio.m06.p3.beat.spoken: Marked silos only. That grain is fuel.

radio.m06.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m06.p4.beat.text: SERA: Five answering the smoke, in two groups. Turn into them.
radio.m06.p4.beat.spoken: Five answering the smoke, in two groups. Turn into them.

radio.m06.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m06.p5.beat.text: SERA: The farm crew found the ledger. Hold the link while they read it.
radio.m06.p5.beat.spoken: The farm crew found the ledger. Hold the link while they read it.

radio.m06.p5.chatter1.speaker: FARMER
radio.m06.p5.chatter1.text: FARMER: Three fuel shipments. All signed by the same officer.
radio.m06.p5.chatter1.spoken: Three fuel shipments. All signed by the same officer.

radio.m07.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p1.beat.text: SERA: The courier runs under the dust. Stay in it.
radio.m07.p1.beat.spoken: The courier runs under the dust. Stay in it.

radio.m07.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Five escorts ahead of him. Dust is thinning.
radio.m07.p1.chatter1.spoken: Five escorts ahead of him. Dust is thinning.

radio.m07.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p2.beat.text: SERA: Scan both clearings for his engine trail.
radio.m07.p2.beat.spoken: Scan both clearings for his engine trail.

radio.m07.p2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p2.chatter1.text: SERA: Engine trail at the second clearing. Keep low.
radio.m07.p2.chatter1.spoken: Engine trail at the second clearing. Keep low.

radio.m07.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p3.beat.text: SERA: Five escorts in the dust, in two groups. Strip them off him.
radio.m07.p3.beat.spoken: Five escorts in the dust, in two groups. Strip them off him.

radio.m07.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p4.beat.text: SERA: There's the courier, running north. Ninety seconds. Catch him.
radio.m07.p4.beat.spoken: There's the courier, running north. Ninety seconds. Catch him.

radio.m07.p4.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p4.chatter1.text: SERA: He's halfway to the plateau. Close on him.
radio.m07.p4.chatter1.spoken: He's halfway to the plateau. Close on him.

radio.m07.p4.chatter2.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p4.chatter2.text: SERA: Twenty seconds and he's over the edge!
radio.m07.p4.chatter2.spoken: Twenty seconds and he's over the edge!

radio.m07.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p5.beat.text: SERA: Packet recovered. Head for Varda while I read the orders.
radio.m07.p5.beat.spoken: Packet recovered. Head for Varda while I read the orders.

radio.m07.p5.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m07.p5.chatter1.text: SERA: Tomorrow's orders copied. Reading the signatures next.
radio.m07.p5.chatter1.spoken: Tomorrow's orders copied. Reading the signatures next.

radio.m08.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m08.p1.beat.text: SERA: Tower crew resetting the code. Keep the raiders off them.
radio.m08.p1.beat.spoken: Tower crew resetting the code. Keep the raiders off them.

radio.m08.p1.chatter1.speaker: BROADCAST
radio.m08.p1.chatter1.text: BROADCAST: Varda tower is in rebel hands. Fire on it.
radio.m08.p1.chatter1.spoken: Varda tower is in rebel hands. Fire on it.

radio.m08.p1.chatter3.speaker: SERA
radio.m08.p1.chatter3.text: SERA: Second wave's dropping smoke on the apron. Spotters.
radio.m08.p1.chatter3.spoken: Second wave's dropping smoke on the apron. Spotters.

radio.m08.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m08.p2.beat.text: SERA: Smoke on the apron. Scan for the two spotter dishes first.
radio.m08.p2.beat.spoken: Smoke on the apron. Scan for the two spotter dishes first.

radio.m08.p2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m08.p2.chatter1.text: SERA: Two dishes in the smoke. Keep the parked trainers clear.
radio.m08.p2.chatter1.spoken: Two dishes in the smoke. Keep the parked trainers clear.

radio.m08.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m08.p3.beat.text: SERA: Code is ours. Two spotter radars on the apron. Hit them.
radio.m08.p3.beat.spoken: Code is ours. Two spotter radars on the apron. Hit them.

radio.m08.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m08.p4.beat.text: SERA: Spotters down. Their flight is running. Catch three.
radio.m08.p4.beat.spoken: Spotters down. Their flight is running. Catch three.

radio.m08.p5.beat.speaker: TOWER
radio.m08.p5.beat.text: TOWER: Code restored. Stay on the link until every loyal flight answers.
radio.m08.p5.beat.spoken: Code restored. Stay on the link until every loyal flight answers.

radio.m08.p5.chatter1.speaker: TOWER
radio.m08.p5.chatter1.text: TOWER: Loyal flight answering. Waiting on the last one.
radio.m08.p5.chatter1.spoken: Loyal flight answering. Waiting on the last one.

radio.m09.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m09.p1.beat.text: SERA: The approach lights are his bait. Fly them anyway.
radio.m09.p1.beat.spoken: The approach lights are his bait. Fly them anyway.

radio.m09.p1.chatter1.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
radio.m09.p1.chatter1.text: VULTURE LEAD: Teal flew this line too. Keep coming.
radio.m09.p1.chatter1.spoken: Teal flew this line too. Keep coming.

radio.m09.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m09.p2.beat.text: SERA: His voice is bouncing off the pass. Scan low to mark the source.
radio.m09.p2.beat.spoken: His voice is bouncing off the pass. Scan low to mark the source.

radio.m09.p2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m09.p2.chatter1.text: SERA: Guard-channel source above the pass. That is him.
radio.m09.p2.chatter1.spoken: Guard-channel source above the pass. That is him.

radio.m09.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m09.p3.beat.text: SERA: Three on night vision, in two groups. Watch your horizon.
radio.m09.p3.beat.spoken: Three on night vision, in two groups. Watch your horizon.

radio.m09.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m09.p4.beat.text: SERA: Patrol is gone. Hold the channel open. He will come to answer.
radio.m09.p4.beat.spoken: Patrol is gone. Hold the channel open. He will come to answer.

radio.m09.p4.chatter1.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
radio.m09.p4.chatter1.text: VULTURE LEAD: You have my attention, trainee. Stay there.
radio.m09.p4.chatter1.spoken: You have my attention, trainee. Stay there.

radio.m09.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m09.p5.beat.text: Vulture Lead. He erased the witness. Not you.
radio.m09.p5.beat.spoken: Vulture Lead. He erased the witness. Not you.

radio.m09.p6.beat.speaker: RECOVERY
radio.m09.p6.beat.text: RECOVERY: Recorder still transmitting. Mark it before the signal dies.
radio.m09.p6.beat.spoken: Recorder still transmitting. Mark it before the signal dies.

radio.m09.p6.chatter1.speaker: RECOVERY
radio.m09.p6.chatter1.text: RECOVERY: Recorder ping steady. Mark the second slope.
radio.m09.p6.chatter1.spoken: Recorder ping steady. Mark the second slope.

radio.m09.ace.stage1.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
radio.m09.ace.stage1.text: VULTURE LEAD: You fly like him. He died anyway. Wing, cut him off.
radio.m09.ace.stage1.spoken: You fly like him. He died anyway. Wing, cut him off.

radio.m09.ace.stage2.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
radio.m09.ace.stage2.text: VULTURE LEAD: Enough. Wing, on me!

radio.m09.ace.return1.speaker: SERA
radio.m09.ace.return1.text: SERA: Vulture Lead's turning back in. Nose on him.
radio.m09.ace.return1.spoken: Vulture Lead's turning back in. Nose on him.

radio.m09.ace.return2.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
radio.m09.ace.return2.text: VULTURE LEAD: Head on, trainee. Like he did.
radio.m09.ace.return2.spoken: Head on, trainee. Like he did.

radio.m09.ace.call1.speaker: SERA
radio.m09.ace.call1.text: SERA: VULTURE LEAD pulled back to call his wing. 1 inbound.
radio.m09.ace.call1.spoken: Vulture Lead pulled back to call his wing. One inbound.

radio.m09.ace.call2.speaker: SERA
radio.m09.ace.call2.text: SERA: VULTURE LEAD pulled back to call his wing. 2 inbound.
radio.m09.ace.call2.spoken: Vulture Lead pulled back to call his wing. Two inbound.

radio.m10.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p1.beat.text: SERA: Scan the archive first. The dish can wait.
radio.m10.p1.beat.spoken: Scan the archive first. The dish can wait.

radio.m10.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Signatures copying. Stay low. Hold fire.
radio.m10.p1.chatter1.spoken: Signatures copying. Stay low. Hold fire.

radio.m10.p1.twist.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p1.twist.text: SERA: They've seen you. Four climbing off the camp. Scan's on hold.
radio.m10.p1.twist.spoken: They've seen you. Four climbing off the camp. Scan's on hold.

radio.m10.p1.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p1.t1.beat.text: SERA: Four off the camp, in pairs. Clear them, then we finish the scan.
radio.m10.p1.t1.beat.spoken: Four off the camp, in pairs. Clear them, then we finish the scan.

radio.m10.p1.t2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p1.t2.beat.text: SERA: Back on the archive. Eight seconds of clean copy.
radio.m10.p1.t2.beat.spoken: Back on the archive. Eight seconds of clean copy.

radio.m10.p1.t2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p1.t2.chatter1.text: SERA: Copy complete in four. Hold your line.
radio.m10.p1.t2.chatter1.spoken: Copy complete in four. Hold your line.

radio.m10.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p2.beat.text: SERA: Archive copied. Cut the transmitter.

radio.m10.p2.twist.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p2.twist.text: SERA: Radar is directing them. Hold the channel; we will trace it.
radio.m10.p2.twist.spoken: Radar is directing them. Hold the channel; we will trace it.

radio.m10.p2.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p2.t1.beat.text: SERA: Hold the channel while we trace the camp radar.
radio.m10.p2.t1.beat.spoken: Hold the channel while we trace the camp radar.

radio.m10.p2.t1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p2.t1.chatter1.text: SERA: The radar is still directing them. Trace is closing.
radio.m10.p2.t1.chatter1.spoken: The radar is still directing them. Trace is closing.

radio.m10.p2.t2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p2.t2.beat.text: SERA: Radar on the camp roof. Its raiders fire twice as fast. Kill it.
radio.m10.p2.t2.beat.spoken: Radar on the camp roof. Its raiders fire twice as fast. Kill it.

radio.m10.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m10.p3.beat.text: SERA: Radar's dead. The response is flying blind. Three.
radio.m10.p3.beat.spoken: Radar's dead. The response is flying blind. Three.

radio.m11.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m11.p1.beat.text: SERA: Lira first. West ridge dish.

radio.m11.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m11.p2.beat.text: SERA: Alert flight airborne. Three. Clear them.
radio.m11.p2.beat.spoken: Alert flight airborne. Three. Clear them.

radio.m11.p3.twist.speaker: SERA
radio.m11.p3.twist.text: SERA: Third dish lit north of the belt. Node Sable. Not on the tin.
radio.m11.p3.twist.spoken: Third dish lit north of the belt. Node Sable. Not on the tin.

radio.m11.p3.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m11.p3.t1.beat.text: SERA: Farm road north. Two beacons to Sable.
radio.m11.p3.t1.beat.spoken: Farm road north. Two beacons to Sable.

radio.m11.p3.t1.chatter1.speaker: FARMER
radio.m11.p3.t1.chatter1.text: FARMER: That dish went up last week. Nobody asked us.
radio.m11.p3.t1.chatter1.spoken: That dish went up last week. Nobody asked us.

radio.m11.p3.t2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m11.p3.t2.beat.text: SERA: Sable. Dish only. The barn beside it is ours.
radio.m11.p3.t2.beat.spoken: Sable. Dish only. The barn beside it is ours.

radio.m11.p3.t3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m11.p3.t3.beat.text: SERA: Guard flight off Sable. Three.

radio.m11.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m11.p4.beat.text: SERA: Relaying Teal's packet. Ninety seconds. Hold the ridge orbit.
radio.m11.p4.beat.spoken: Relaying Teal's packet. Ninety seconds. Hold the ridge orbit.

radio.m11.p4.chatter1.speaker: FARMER
radio.m11.p4.chatter1.text: FARMER: We're hearing it. Keep it coming.
radio.m11.p4.chatter1.spoken: We're hearing it. Keep it coming.

radio.m11.p4.chatter2.speaker: SERA
radio.m11.p4.chatter2.text: SERA: Last of the packet. Don't drift off the ridge.
radio.m11.p4.chatter2.spoken: Last of the packet. Don't drift off the ridge.

radio.m12.p1.beat.speaker: TRUCK
radio.m12.p1.beat.text: TRUCK: Transmitter rolling. The corridor is full of refugees.
radio.m12.p1.beat.spoken: Transmitter rolling. The corridor is full of refugees.

radio.m12.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m12.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Second flight coming for the truck.
radio.m12.p1.chatter1.spoken: Second flight coming for the truck.

radio.m12.p1.twist.speaker: BROADCAST
radio.m12.p1.twist.text: BROADCAST: Convoy, the north corridor is clear. Proceed north at speed.
radio.m12.p1.twist.spoken: Convoy, the north corridor is clear. Proceed north at speed.

radio.m12.p1.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m12.p1.t1.beat.text: SERA: Ignore him. North is mined. Truck, stop. Scan the mill road.
radio.m12.p1.t1.beat.spoken: Ignore him. North is mined. Truck, stop. Scan the mill road.

radio.m12.p1.t1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m12.p1.t1.chatter1.text: SERA: Refugees clear of the bend. One more look at the road.
radio.m12.p1.t1.chatter1.spoken: Refugees clear of the bend. One more look at the road.

radio.m12.p1.t2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m12.p1.t2.beat.text: SERA: Mill road is clear. Truck, swing east. We will cover you.
radio.m12.p1.t2.beat.spoken: Mill road is clear. Truck, swing east. We will cover you.

radio.m12.p1.t2.chatter1.speaker: TRUCK
radio.m12.p1.t2.chatter1.text: TRUCK: Mill road's rough but we're moving. Stay with us.
radio.m12.p1.t2.chatter1.spoken: Mill road's rough but we're moving. Stay with us.

radio.m12.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m12.p2.beat.text: SERA: Truck's clear. Patrol escalating. Six, in two groups.
radio.m12.p2.beat.spoken: Truck's clear. Patrol escalating. Six, in two groups.

radio.m12.p3.beat.speaker: TRUCK
radio.m12.p3.beat.text: TRUCK: Parked and transmitting. Hold for our first reply.
radio.m12.p3.beat.spoken: Parked and transmitting. Hold for our first reply.

radio.m12.p3.chatter1.speaker: TRUCK
radio.m12.p3.chatter1.text: TRUCK: First loyalist cell answering. Holding for the second.
radio.m12.p3.chatter1.spoken: First loyalist cell answering. Holding for the second.

radio.m12.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m12.p4.beat.text: SERA: Relief crew following your beacons. Bring them to the truck.
radio.m12.p4.beat.spoken: Relief crew following your beacons. Bring them to the truck.

radio.m12.p4.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m12.p4.chatter1.text: SERA: Relief crew sees the transmitter. Last beacon ahead.
radio.m12.p4.chatter1.spoken: Relief crew sees the transmitter. Last beacon ahead.

radio.m13.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m13.p1.beat.text: SERA: Rail spur runs straight to their stores. Follow it.
radio.m13.p1.beat.spoken: Rail spur runs straight to their stores. Follow it.

radio.m13.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m13.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Spur ends at the silos. Low and quiet now.
radio.m13.p1.chatter1.spoken: Spur ends at the silos. Low and quiet now.

radio.m13.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m13.p2.beat.text: SERA: Mark the stores. Civilian roofs stay standing.
radio.m13.p2.beat.spoken: Mark the stores. Civilian roofs stay standing.

radio.m13.p2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m13.p2.chatter1.text: SERA: Fuel ledger confirmed. Those silos are military.
radio.m13.p2.chatter1.spoken: Fuel ledger confirmed. Those silos are military.

radio.m13.p3.twist.speaker: SERA
radio.m13.p3.twist.text: SERA: Four off the plateau. Finish the silos, then turn into them.
radio.m13.p3.twist.spoken: Four off the plateau. Finish the silos, then turn into them.

radio.m13.p3.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m13.p3.t1.beat.text: SERA: Silos burning. Now the four, in pairs. Turn in.
radio.m13.p3.t1.beat.spoken: Silos burning. Now the four, in pairs. Turn in.

radio.m13.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m13.p4.beat.text: SERA: The relay's still calling for help. Cut it.
radio.m13.p4.beat.spoken: The relay's still calling for help. Cut it.

radio.m13.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m13.p5.beat.text: SERA: Raiders off the plateau. Three more, with hangers-on.
radio.m13.p5.beat.spoken: Raiders off the plateau. Three more, with hangers-on.

radio.m13.p6.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m13.p6.beat.text: SERA: Rail crew has the ledger. Hold the link to the cells.
radio.m13.p6.beat.spoken: Rail crew has the ledger. Hold the link to the cells.

radio.m13.p6.chatter1.speaker: LOYALIST
radio.m13.p6.chatter1.text: LOYALIST: Rail ledger copied. Matching it against Kiro's orders.
radio.m13.p6.chatter1.spoken: Rail ledger copied. Matching it against Kiro's orders.

radio.m14.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p1.beat.text: SERA: Saddle beacons lead to the arrays. Climb.
radio.m14.p1.beat.spoken: Saddle beacons lead to the arrays. Climb.

radio.m14.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: All three arrays can hear you now.
radio.m14.p1.chatter1.spoken: All three arrays can hear you now.

radio.m14.p1.chatter2.speaker: BROADCAST
radio.m14.p1.chatter2.text: BROADCAST: Unknown aircraft on the saddle. Intercept.
radio.m14.p1.chatter2.spoken: Unknown aircraft on the saddle. Intercept.

radio.m14.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p2.beat.text: SERA: Three dishes on the ridge. Blind them.
radio.m14.p2.beat.spoken: Three dishes on the ridge. Blind them.

radio.m14.p2.twist.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p2.twist.text: SERA: Replacement mast on the saddle road. Cut that one too.
radio.m14.p2.twist.spoken: Replacement mast on the saddle road. Cut that one too.

radio.m14.p2.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p2.t1.beat.text: SERA: Scan the saddle road. They have raised a replacement dish.
radio.m14.p2.t1.beat.spoken: Scan the saddle road. They have raised a replacement dish.

radio.m14.p2.t1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p2.t1.chatter1.text: SERA: Dish truck on the saddle road. Civilian vans are clear.
radio.m14.p2.t1.chatter1.spoken: Dish truck on the saddle road. Civilian vans are clear.

radio.m14.p2.t2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p2.t2.beat.text: SERA: Mast located on the saddle road. Hit the dish.
radio.m14.p2.t2.beat.spoken: Mast located on the saddle road. Hit the dish.

radio.m14.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p3.beat.text: SERA: Perimeter CAP turning in. Four, in pairs, with raiders.
radio.m14.p3.beat.spoken: Perimeter cap turning in. Four, in pairs, with raiders.

radio.m14.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p4.beat.text: SERA: Hold the saddle. I'm listening for anything left alive.
radio.m14.p4.beat.spoken: Hold the saddle. I'm listening for anything left alive.

radio.m14.p4.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p4.chatter1.text: SERA: More off the dark end of the row. Hold the orbit.
radio.m14.p4.chatter1.spoken: More off the dark end of the row. Hold the orbit.

radio.m14.p4.chatter2.speaker: SERA
radio.m14.p4.chatter2.text: SERA: Nothing on the chain. Almost there.
radio.m14.p4.chatter2.spoken: Nothing on the chain. Almost there.

radio.m15.p1.beat.speaker: LOYALIST
radio.m15.p1.beat.text: LOYALIST: Transmitting. Every second is a garrison.
radio.m15.p1.beat.spoken: Transmitting. Every second is a garrison.

radio.m15.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m15.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Raiders inbound. Stay inside the volume.
radio.m15.p1.chatter1.spoken: Raiders inbound. Stay inside the volume.

radio.m15.p1.chatter2.speaker: LOYALIST
radio.m15.p1.chatter2.text: LOYALIST: Garrisons answering. Keep the volume.

radio.m15.p1.hazard.speaker: LOYALIST
radio.m15.p1.hazard.text: LOYALIST: Link lost! Kill the two jammer trucks on the farm road.
radio.m15.p1.hazard.spoken: Link lost! Kill the two jammer trucks on the farm road.

radio.m15.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m15.p2.beat.text: SERA: Second wave, riding harder. Seven, in two groups. Raiders in tow.
radio.m15.p2.beat.spoken: Second wave, riding harder. Seven, in two groups. Raiders in tow.

radio.m15.p3.beat.speaker: LOYALIST
radio.m15.p3.beat.text: LOYALIST: Two reply beacons lit. Follow them to check the garrisons.
radio.m15.p3.beat.spoken: Two reply beacons lit. Follow them to check the garrisons.

radio.m15.p3.chatter1.speaker: LOYALIST
radio.m15.p3.chatter1.text: LOYALIST: West garrison beacon confirmed. East is ahead.
radio.m15.p3.chatter1.spoken: West garrison beacon confirmed. East is ahead.

radio.m15.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m15.p4.beat.text: SERA: Scan both compounds for parked aircraft. Verify they stood down.
radio.m15.p4.beat.spoken: Scan both compounds for parked aircraft. Verify they stood down.

radio.m15.p4.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m15.p4.chatter1.text: SERA: Engines cold at the first compound. Check the second.
radio.m15.p4.chatter1.spoken: Engines cold at the first compound. Check the second.

radio.m16.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p1.beat.text: SERA: River gates keep you under the storm. Stay low.
radio.m16.p1.beat.spoken: River gates keep you under the storm. Stay low.

radio.m16.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Last gate. The marked tanks are just past it.
radio.m16.p1.chatter1.spoken: Last gate. The marked tanks are just past it.

radio.m16.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p2.beat.text: SERA: Rain hides the markings. Scan both ends before you fire.
radio.m16.p2.beat.spoken: Rain hides the markings. Scan both ends before you fire.

radio.m16.p2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p2.chatter1.text: SERA: Fuel markings visible. Keep the farm roofs out of the strike.
radio.m16.p2.chatter1.spoken: Fuel markings visible. Keep the farm roofs out of the strike.

radio.m16.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p3.beat.text: SERA: Three silos under the storm. Burn them.
radio.m16.p3.beat.spoken: Three silos under the storm. Burn them.

radio.m16.p3.twist.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p3.twist.text: SERA: Five diving through the cloud. Finish the tanks and turn.
radio.m16.p3.twist.spoken: Five diving through the cloud. Finish the tanks and turn.

radio.m16.p3.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p3.t1.beat.text: SERA: Patrol riding the thunder. Five, in two groups.
radio.m16.p3.t1.beat.spoken: Patrol riding the thunder. Five, in two groups.

radio.m16.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p4.beat.text: SERA: Forward relay on the staging path. Cut it.
radio.m16.p4.beat.spoken: Forward relay on the staging path. Cut it.

radio.m16.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p5.beat.text: SERA: Hold over the relay. Its last traffic is still in the air.
radio.m16.p5.beat.spoken: Hold over the relay. Its last traffic is still in the air.

radio.m16.p5.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p5.chatter1.text: SERA: Pair off the plateau, using the storm. Hold the orbit.
radio.m16.p5.chatter1.spoken: Pair off the plateau, using the storm. Hold the orbit.

radio.m16.p5.chatter2.speaker: SERA
radio.m16.p5.chatter2.text: SERA: Second pair, coming out of the rain.
radio.m16.p5.chatter2.spoken: Second pair, coming out of the rain.

radio.m17.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m17.p1.beat.text: SERA: One dish under the aurora. Cut it.
radio.m17.p1.beat.spoken: One dish under the aurora. Cut it.

radio.m17.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m17.p2.beat.text: SERA: Four intercepts lit by the aurora, in pairs.
radio.m17.p2.beat.spoken: Four intercepts lit by the aurora, in pairs.

radio.m17.p3.beat.speaker: TEAL
radio.m17.p3.beat.text: TEAL (tape): If you hear this up here, read the signature.
radio.m17.p3.beat.spoken: If you hear this up here, read the signature.

radio.m17.p3.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m17.p3.chatter1.text: SERA: The archive is speaking. Signature decoding.
radio.m17.p3.chatter1.spoken: The archive is speaking. Signature decoding.

radio.m17.p3.twist.speaker: SERA
radio.m17.p3.twist.text: SERA: Archive lost. Jammer under the array. Find it, low.
radio.m17.p3.twist.spoken: Archive lost. Jammer under the array. Find it, low.

radio.m17.p3.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m17.p3.t1.beat.text: SERA: Get under the aurora glow. It'll show on the scan.
radio.m17.p3.t1.beat.spoken: Get under the aurora glow. It'll show on the scan.

radio.m17.p3.t1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m17.p3.t1.chatter1.text: SERA: There. A dish truck in the array's shadow.
radio.m17.p3.t1.chatter1.spoken: There. A dish truck in the array's shadow.

radio.m17.p3.t3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m17.p3.t3.beat.text: SERA: Its escort is up. Two.

radio.m17.p3.t4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m17.p3.t4.beat.text: SERA: Archive's back. Hold the orbit. Read the signature.
radio.m17.p3.t4.beat.spoken: Archive's back. Hold the orbit. Read the signature.

radio.m17.p3.t4.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m17.p3.t4.chatter1.text: SERA: Signature decoding. Hold. It carries a Marshal's seal.
radio.m17.p3.t4.chatter1.spoken: Signature decoding. Hold. It carries a Marshal's seal.

radio.m18.p1.beat.speaker: VULTURE TWO
radio.m18.p1.beat.text: VULTURE TWO: Climb into my lights, trainee.

radio.m18.p1.chatter1.speaker: VULTURE TWO
radio.m18.p1.chatter1.text: VULTURE TWO: Teal climbed faster. Show me more.
radio.m18.p1.chatter1.spoken: Teal climbed faster. Show me more.

radio.m18.p2.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m18.p2.beat.text: MARINE: Mark a clear pickup site. We need his answers alive.
radio.m18.p2.beat.spoken: Mark a clear pickup site. We need his answers alive.

radio.m18.p2.chatter1.speaker: MARINE
radio.m18.p2.chatter1.text: MARINE: Ridge landing zone clear. We can bring a helo there.
