radio.m18.p2.chatter1.spoken: Ridge landing zone clear. We can bring a helo there.

radio.m18.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m18.p3.beat.text: SERA: His wingmen first. Four, in pairs.
radio.m18.p3.beat.spoken: His wingmen first. Four, in pairs.

radio.m18.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m18.p4.beat.text: He flies like Teal. Teal learned it from him.
radio.m18.p4.beat.spoken: He flies like Teal. Teal learned it from him.

radio.m18.p4.twist.speaker: SERA
radio.m18.p4.twist.text: SERA: Chute open. His wing is turning back. Cover the marines' pickup.
radio.m18.p4.twist.spoken: Chute open. His wing is turning back. Cover the marines' pickup.

radio.m18.p4.t1.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m18.p4.t1.beat.text: MARINE: We have him. Forty-five seconds to get him off the ridge.
radio.m18.p4.t1.beat.spoken: We have him. Forty-five seconds to get him off the ridge.

radio.m18.p4.t1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m18.p4.t1.chatter1.text: SERA: His second pair is diving on the pickup. Hold them.
radio.m18.p4.t1.chatter1.spoken: His second pair is diving on the pickup. Hold them.

radio.m18.p4.t1.chatter2.speaker: MARINE
radio.m18.p4.t1.chatter2.text: MARINE: Helo's spinning up. Almost out.

radio.m18.p5.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m18.p5.beat.text: MARINE: He is talking. Coast is recording. Hold the link.
radio.m18.p5.beat.spoken: He is talking. Coast is recording. Hold the link.

radio.m18.p5.chatter1.speaker: MARINE
radio.m18.p5.chatter1.text: MARINE: He admits the handwriting. Coast is recording every word.
radio.m18.p5.chatter1.spoken: He admits the handwriting. Coast is recording every word.

radio.m18.ace.stage1.speaker: VULTURE TWO
radio.m18.ace.stage1.text: VULTURE TWO: I taught him that turn. Wing, show the trainee the answer.
radio.m18.ace.stage1.spoken: I taught him that turn. Wing, show the trainee the answer.

radio.m18.ace.stage2.speaker: VULTURE TWO
radio.m18.ace.stage2.text: VULTURE TWO: Last lesson. Wing, keep him busy.
radio.m18.ace.stage2.spoken: Last lesson. Wing, keep him busy.

radio.m18.ace.return1.speaker: VULTURE TWO
radio.m18.ace.return1.text: VULTURE TWO: Now. Again, trainee. From the top.
radio.m18.ace.return1.spoken: Now. Again, trainee. From the top.

radio.m18.ace.return2.speaker: VULTURE TWO
radio.m18.ace.return2.text: VULTURE TWO: Head on. The way Teal never would.
radio.m18.ace.return2.spoken: Head on. The way Teal never would.

radio.m18.ace.call1.speaker: SERA
radio.m18.ace.call1.text: SERA: VULTURE TWO pulled back to call his wing. 1 inbound.
radio.m18.ace.call1.spoken: Vulture Two pulled back to call his wing. One inbound.

radio.m18.ace.call2.speaker: SERA
radio.m18.ace.call2.text: SERA: VULTURE TWO pulled back to call his wing. 2 inbound.
radio.m18.ace.call2.spoken: Vulture Two pulled back to call his wing. Two inbound.

radio.m19.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m19.p1.beat.text: SERA: Watch what the cranes unload. Mark the quays.
radio.m19.p1.beat.spoken: Watch what the cranes unload. Mark the quays.

radio.m19.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m19.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Those crates are munitions. The quays are military.
radio.m19.p1.chatter1.spoken: Those crates are munitions. The quays are military.

radio.m19.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m19.p2.beat.text: SERA: Three military quays. Hit the warehouses.
radio.m19.p2.beat.spoken: Three military quays. Hit the warehouses.

radio.m19.p2.twist.speaker: SERA
radio.m19.p2.twist.text: SERA: Early CAP pair launching. Finish the quay, then turn in.
radio.m19.p2.twist.spoken: Early cap pair launching. Finish the quay, then turn in.

radio.m19.p2.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m19.p2.t1.beat.text: SERA: Early pair off the apron. Clear them.
radio.m19.p2.t1.beat.spoken: Early pair off the apron. Clear them.

radio.m19.p3.beat.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m19.p3.beat.text: HARBOR: Follow the three quay beacons. Our launch needs a clear way out.
radio.m19.p3.beat.spoken: Follow the three quay beacons. Our launch needs a clear way out.

radio.m19.p3.chatter1.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m19.p3.chatter1.text: HARBOR: First bend clear. Last beacon marks the open channel.
radio.m19.p3.chatter1.spoken: First bend clear. Last beacon marks the open channel.

radio.m19.p4.beat.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m19.p4.beat.text: HARBOR: Workers aboard. Cover our launch clear of the burning quays.
radio.m19.p4.beat.spoken: Workers aboard. Cover our launch clear of the burning quays.

radio.m19.p4.chatter1.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m19.p4.chatter1.text: HARBOR: All workers counted. Past the worst of the smoke.
radio.m19.p4.chatter1.spoken: All workers counted. Past the worst of the smoke.

radio.m19.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m19.p5.beat.text: SERA: Main CAP off the apron. Four, in two groups.
radio.m19.p5.beat.spoken: Main cap off the apron. Four, in two groups.

radio.m19.p6.beat.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m19.p6.beat.text: HARBOR: Quays clear. Hold the channel while we count our people.
radio.m19.p6.beat.spoken: Quays clear. Hold the channel while we count our people.

radio.m19.p6.chatter1.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m19.p6.chatter1.text: HARBOR: First crew answering. Still calling the eastern quay.
radio.m19.p6.chatter1.spoken: First crew answering. Still calling the eastern quay.

radio.m20.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m20.p1.beat.text: SERA: Full wing on the east line. Nine, in three groups.
radio.m20.p1.beat.spoken: Full wing on the east line. Nine, in three groups.

radio.m20.p2.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m20.p2.beat.text: MARINE: Paper is aboard. Scan the harbor exit before we move.
radio.m20.p2.beat.spoken: Paper is aboard. Scan the harbor exit before we move.

radio.m20.p2.chatter1.speaker: MARINE
radio.m20.p2.chatter1.text: MARINE: Exit marked. We will move as soon as your scan is clear.
radio.m20.p2.chatter1.spoken: Exit marked. We will move as soon as your scan is clear.

radio.m20.p3.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m20.p3.beat.text: MARINE: Launch moving. Keep the sky quiet.
radio.m20.p3.beat.spoken: Launch moving. Keep the sky quiet.

radio.m20.p3.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m20.p3.chatter1.text: SERA: Western wing reacting. Launch is halfway out.
radio.m20.p3.chatter1.spoken: Western wing reacting. Launch is halfway out.

radio.m20.p3.hazard.speaker: MARINE
radio.m20.p3.hazard.text: MARINE: Guns on both banks, firing on the launch! Silence them!
radio.m20.p3.hazard.spoken: Guns on both banks, firing on the launch! Silence them!

radio.m20.p4.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m20.p4.beat.text: MARINE: Holding at the exit. Mark the patrol boat's approach beacons.
radio.m20.p4.beat.spoken: Holding at the exit. Mark the patrol boat's approach beacons.

radio.m20.p4.chatter1.speaker: MARINE
radio.m20.p4.chatter1.text: MARINE: Patrol boat sees your mark. One more beacon.
radio.m20.p4.chatter1.spoken: Patrol boat sees your mark. One more beacon.

radio.m20.p5.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m20.p5.beat.text: MARINE: Patrol boat alongside. Hold until the paper changes hands.
radio.m20.p5.beat.spoken: Patrol boat alongside. Hold until the paper changes hands.

radio.m20.p5.chatter1.speaker: MARINE
radio.m20.p5.chatter1.text: MARINE: Archive case passed. Tapes are next.
radio.m20.p5.chatter1.spoken: Archive case passed. Tapes are next.

radio.m21.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m21.p1.beat.text: SERA: The dark canal keeps you off his radar. Follow it.
radio.m21.p1.beat.spoken: The dark canal keeps you off his radar. Follow it.

radio.m21.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m21.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Relay above the apartments. Hit only the dish.
radio.m21.p1.chatter1.spoken: Relay above the apartments. Hit only the dish.

radio.m21.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m21.p2.beat.text: SERA: Low scan over the canal. Mark the dish above the roofs.
radio.m21.p2.beat.spoken: Low scan over the canal. Mark the dish above the roofs.

radio.m21.p2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m21.p2.chatter1.text: SERA: Dish marked. Apartment roofs stay standing.
radio.m21.p2.chatter1.spoken: Dish marked. Apartment roofs stay standing.

radio.m21.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m21.p3.beat.text: SERA: Broadcast relay above the city. Dish only.
radio.m21.p3.beat.spoken: Broadcast relay above the city. Dish only.

radio.m21.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m21.p4.beat.text: SERA: Escort flight scrambling. Four, in two pairs.
radio.m21.p4.beat.spoken: Escort flight scrambling. Four, in two pairs.

radio.m21.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m21.p5.beat.text: SERA: Hold over the tower. I want to hear nothing from it.
radio.m21.p5.beat.spoken: Hold over the tower. I want to hear nothing from it.

radio.m21.p5.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m21.p5.chatter1.text: SERA: Pair off the dark side of the city. Hold the orbit.
radio.m21.p5.chatter1.spoken: Pair off the dark side of the city. Hold the orbit.

radio.m21.p6.beat.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m21.p6.beat.text: HARBOR: Repair crew moving. Cover us to the dark district.
radio.m21.p6.beat.spoken: Repair crew moving. Cover us to the dark district.

radio.m21.p6.chatter1.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m21.p6.chatter1.text: HARBOR: Crew passing the canal bend. Keep the approach clear.
radio.m21.p6.chatter1.spoken: Crew passing the canal bend. Keep the approach clear.

radio.m21.p7.beat.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m21.p7.beat.text: HARBOR: Launch moored. Follow district lights to guide the shore crew.
radio.m21.p7.beat.spoken: Launch moored. Follow district lights to guide the shore crew.

radio.m21.p7.chatter1.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m21.p7.chatter1.text: HARBOR: Shore crew sees your mark. Moving to the next street.
radio.m21.p7.chatter1.spoken: Shore crew sees your mark. Moving to the next street.

radio.m22.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m22.p1.beat.text: SERA: The fog depots carry his signature. Find them.
radio.m22.p1.beat.spoken: The fog depots carry his signature. Find them.

radio.m22.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m22.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Permits match. Every depot is fuel.
radio.m22.p1.chatter1.spoken: Permits match. Every depot is fuel.

radio.m22.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m22.p2.beat.text: SERA: Five depots in the fog. All marked.
radio.m22.p2.beat.spoken: Five depots in the fog. All marked.

radio.m22.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m22.p3.beat.text: SERA: Follow the pier beacons. Check the whole fuel line is cut.
radio.m22.p3.beat.spoken: Follow the pier beacons. Check the whole fuel line is cut.

radio.m22.p3.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m22.p3.chatter1.text: SERA: West pier empty. Follow the lights to the east.
radio.m22.p3.chatter1.spoken: West pier empty. Follow the lights to the east.

radio.m22.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m22.p4.beat.text: SERA: Patrol riding the fog. Four, in two pairs.
radio.m22.p4.beat.spoken: Patrol riding the fog. Four, in two pairs.

radio.m22.p5.beat.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m22.p5.beat.text: HARBOR: Cannot see the piers. Cover us while we check the hoses.
radio.m22.p5.beat.spoken: Cannot see the piers. Cover us while we check the hoses.

radio.m22.p5.chatter1.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m22.p5.chatter1.text: HARBOR: Inspectors at the central pier. Fuel line looks dry.
radio.m22.p5.chatter1.spoken: Inspectors at the central pier. Fuel line looks dry.

radio.m22.p6.beat.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m22.p6.beat.text: HARBOR: Scan the last two piers. We need proof every hose is dry.
radio.m22.p6.beat.spoken: Scan the last two piers. We need proof every hose is dry.

radio.m22.p6.chatter1.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m22.p6.chatter1.text: HARBOR: First hose disconnected. Check the eastern pier too.
radio.m22.p6.chatter1.spoken: First hose disconnected. Check the eastern pier too.

radio.m22.p7.beat.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m22.p7.beat.text: HARBOR: Hoses dry. Hold the link for the frigates to copy.
radio.m22.p7.beat.spoken: Hoses dry. Hold the link for the frigates to copy.

radio.m22.p7.chatter1.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m22.p7.chatter1.text: FRIGATE: Report copied. The escape fleet cannot refuel.
radio.m22.p7.chatter1.spoken: Report copied. The escape fleet cannot refuel.

radio.m23.p1.beat.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p1.beat.text: FRIGATE: Ring closing. Raiders on the bow.
radio.m23.p1.beat.spoken: Ring closing. Raiders on the bow.

radio.m23.p1.chatter1.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p1.chatter1.text: FRIGATE: Second group off the platform. Hold them.
radio.m23.p1.chatter1.spoken: Second group off the platform. Hold them.

radio.m23.p1.chatter2.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p1.chatter2.text: FRIGATE: Third group, low on the water. Two left in the ring.
radio.m23.p1.chatter2.spoken: Third group, low on the water. Two left in the ring.

radio.m23.p2.beat.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p2.beat.text: FRIGATE: One gap open. Scan the water before we close the ring.
radio.m23.p2.beat.spoken: One gap open. Scan the water before we close the ring.

radio.m23.p2.chatter1.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p2.chatter1.text: FRIGATE: No wake in the gap. Finish the sweep.
radio.m23.p2.chatter1.spoken: No wake in the gap. Finish the sweep.

radio.m23.p3.beat.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p3.beat.text: FRIGATE: Ring closed. Command flight launching. Four, from both sides.
radio.m23.p3.beat.spoken: Ring closed. Command flight launching. Four, from both sides.

radio.m23.p4.beat.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p4.beat.text: FRIGATE: Follow the outer beacons. Check the whole sea lane is in sight.
radio.m23.p4.beat.spoken: Follow the outer beacons. Check the whole sea lane is in sight.

radio.m23.p4.chatter1.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p4.chatter1.text: FRIGATE: Western lane visible. Sweep to the eastern beacon.
radio.m23.p4.chatter1.spoken: Western lane visible. Sweep to the eastern beacon.

radio.m23.p5.beat.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p5.beat.text: FRIGATE: Inspection launch crossing. Cover it until it docks.
radio.m23.p5.beat.spoken: Inspection launch crossing. Cover it until it docks.

radio.m23.p5.chatter1.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p5.chatter1.text: FRIGATE: Inspection launch halfway across. Gap remains clear.
radio.m23.p5.chatter1.spoken: Inspection launch halfway across. Gap remains clear.

radio.m23.p6.beat.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m23.p6.beat.text: FRIGATE: No ships through. Hold the command link for the landing force.
radio.m23.p6.beat.spoken: No ships through. Hold the command link for the landing force.

radio.m23.p6.chatter1.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
radio.m23.p6.chatter1.text: LANDING FORCE: Ring report received. Bringing our boats forward.
radio.m23.p6.chatter1.spoken: Ring report received. Bringing our boats forward.

radio.m24.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m24.p1.beat.text: SERA: Under the storm. Three gates to the platform.
radio.m24.p1.beat.spoken: Under the storm. Three gates to the platform.

radio.m24.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m24.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Last gate. The deck stores are ahead.
radio.m24.p1.chatter1.spoken: Last gate. The deck stores are ahead.

radio.m24.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m24.p2.beat.text: SERA: Three stores on the deck. Burn them.
radio.m24.p2.beat.spoken: Three stores on the deck. Burn them.

radio.m24.p3.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m24.p3.beat.text: SERA: Patrol in the storm shadow. Five, in two groups.
radio.m24.p3.beat.spoken: Patrol in the storm shadow. Five, in two groups.

radio.m24.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m24.p4.beat.text: SERA: Scan below the cloud. The tanker is hiding behind the deck smoke.
radio.m24.p4.beat.spoken: Scan below the cloud. The tanker is hiding behind the deck smoke.

radio.m24.p4.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m24.p4.chatter1.text: SERA: Engine heat below the cloud. It is running for the coast.
radio.m24.p4.chatter1.spoken: Engine heat below the cloud. It is running for the coast.

radio.m24.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m24.p5.beat.text: SERA: Tanker jet lifting off, running for the coast. Stop it.
radio.m24.p5.beat.spoken: Tanker jet lifting off, running for the coast. Stop it.

radio.m24.p5.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m24.p5.chatter1.text: SERA: Tanker's halfway to the coast. Close on it.
radio.m24.p5.chatter1.spoken: Tanker's halfway to the coast. Close on it.

radio.m24.p5.chatter2.speaker: SERA
radio.m24.p5.chatter2.text: SERA: He's almost over the city. Now!
radio.m24.p5.chatter2.spoken: He's almost over the city. Now!

radio.m24.p6.beat.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m24.p6.beat.text: FRIGATE: Deck crew aboard. Cover them clear of the burning stores.
radio.m24.p6.beat.spoken: Deck crew aboard. Cover them clear of the burning stores.

radio.m24.p6.chatter1.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m24.p6.chatter1.text: FRIGATE: Launch halfway clear. Deck crew accounted for.
radio.m24.p6.chatter1.spoken: Launch halfway clear. Deck crew accounted for.

radio.m24.p7.beat.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m24.p7.beat.text: FRIGATE: Tanker down. Hold while we check for other launches.
radio.m24.p7.beat.spoken: Tanker down. Hold while we check for other launches.

radio.m24.p7.chatter1.speaker: FRIGATE
radio.m24.p7.chatter1.text: FRIGATE: No second tanker on radar. Checking the last deck returns.
radio.m24.p7.chatter1.spoken: No second tanker on radar. Checking the last deck returns.

radio.m25.p1.beat.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
radio.m25.p1.beat.text: LANDING CRAFT: Beach in eighty seconds. Keep them off us.
radio.m25.p1.beat.spoken: Beach in eighty seconds. Keep them off us.

radio.m25.p1.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m25.p1.chatter1.text: SERA: Second intercept launching. Stay on the craft.
radio.m25.p1.chatter1.spoken: Second intercept launching. Stay on the craft.

radio.m25.p1.chatter2.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
radio.m25.p1.chatter2.text: LANDING CRAFT: Surf line. Ramps going down.

radio.m25.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m25.p2.beat.text: SERA: First intercept off the apron. Three, in two groups.
radio.m25.p2.beat.spoken: First intercept off the apron. Three, in two groups.

radio.m25.p3.beat.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
radio.m25.p3.beat.text: LANDING CRAFT: Ramps down. Scan both exits so we can leave the sand.
radio.m25.p3.beat.spoken: Ramps down. Scan both exits so we can leave the sand.

radio.m25.p3.chatter1.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
radio.m25.p3.chatter1.text: LANDING CRAFT: West exit clear. Check the eastern street.
radio.m25.p3.chatter1.spoken: West exit clear. Check the eastern street.

radio.m25.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m25.p4.beat.text: SERA: Second wave with raiders, coming round behind. Hold the beach.
radio.m25.p4.beat.spoken: Second wave with raiders, coming round behind. Hold the beach.

radio.m25.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m25.p5.beat.text: SERA: Beach relay is still directing fire. Cut it.
radio.m25.p5.beat.spoken: Beach relay is still directing fire. Cut it.

radio.m25.p6.beat.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
radio.m25.p6.beat.text: LANDING CRAFT: Streets reached. Hold for both beach exits to answer.
radio.m25.p6.beat.spoken: Streets reached. Hold for both beach exits to answer.

radio.m25.p6.chatter1.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
radio.m25.p6.chatter1.text: LANDING CRAFT: West exit answering. Waiting for the eastern squad.
radio.m25.p6.chatter1.spoken: West exit answering. Waiting for the eastern squad.

radio.m26.p1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m26.p1.beat.text: SERA: Wing splits. Four ahead; the rest will come round behind.
radio.m26.p1.beat.spoken: Wing splits. Four ahead; the rest will come round behind.

radio.m26.p1.group1.speaker: SERA
radio.m26.p1.group1.text: SERA: Second flight on your six! Turn!
radio.m26.p1.group1.spoken: Second flight on your six! Turn!

radio.m26.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m26.p2.beat.text: SERA: Signal bouncing between roofs. Scan low to narrow it down.
radio.m26.p2.beat.spoken: Signal bouncing between roofs. Scan low to narrow it down.

radio.m26.p2.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m26.p2.chatter1.text: SERA: Rooftop echoes mapped. We still need the name of the mast.
radio.m26.p2.chatter1.spoken: Rooftop echoes mapped. We still need the name of the mast.

radio.m26.p3.beat.speaker: TEAL
radio.m26.p3.beat.text: TEAL (tape): He'll be where he can hear himself. The parliament mast.
radio.m26.p3.beat.spoken: He'll be where he can hear himself. The parliament mast.

radio.m26.p3.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m26.p3.chatter1.text: SERA: Triangulating. He's above the parliament transmitter.
radio.m26.p3.chatter1.spoken: Triangulating. He's above the parliament transmitter.

radio.m26.p3.chatter2.speaker: SERA
radio.m26.p3.chatter2.text: SERA: Fix is closing. Stay in the volume.
radio.m26.p3.chatter2.spoken: Fix is closing. Stay in the volume.

radio.m26.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m26.p4.beat.text: SERA: Loyalists marked a corridor. Follow two lights into the city.
radio.m26.p4.beat.spoken: Loyalists marked a corridor. Follow two lights into the city.

radio.m26.p4.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m26.p4.chatter1.text: SERA: Loyalists see your lights. Follow the last city beacon.
radio.m26.p4.chatter1.spoken: Loyalists see your lights. Follow the last city beacon.

radio.m26.p5.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m26.p5.beat.text: MARINE: Secure the quay while witnesses board. Cover the marked site.
radio.m26.p5.beat.spoken: Secure the quay while witnesses board. Cover the marked site.

radio.m26.p5.chatter1.speaker: MARINE
radio.m26.p5.chatter1.text: MARINE: Witnesses boarding. Quay remains secure.

radio.m26.p6.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m26.p6.beat.text: MARINE: Witnesses aboard. Keep us covered until parliament is in sight.
radio.m26.p6.beat.spoken: Witnesses aboard. Keep us covered until parliament is in sight.

radio.m26.p6.chatter1.speaker: MARINE
radio.m26.p6.chatter1.text: MARINE: Parliament in sight. Witnesses still aboard.
radio.m26.p6.chatter1.spoken: Parliament in sight. Witnesses still aboard.

radio.m27.p2.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.p2.beat.text: SERA: His relay is still broadcasting. Cut it.
radio.m27.p2.beat.spoken: His relay is still broadcasting. Cut it.

radio.m27.p2.twist.speaker: RUSK
radio.m27.p2.twist.text: RUSK: You cut one relay. Every loyal pilot still hears me. On me, now.
radio.m27.p2.twist.spoken: You cut one relay. Every loyal pilot still hears me. On me, now.

radio.m27.p2.t1.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.p2.t1.beat.text: SERA: His last escort pair is forming on him. Clear them.
radio.m27.p2.t1.beat.spoken: His last escort pair is forming on him. Clear them.

radio.m27.p3.beat.speaker: MARINE
radio.m27.p3.beat.text: MARINE: Mark the clear road below him. We need Rusk alive to answer.
radio.m27.p3.beat.spoken: Mark the clear road below him. We need Rusk alive to answer.

radio.m27.p3.chatter1.speaker: MARINE
radio.m27.p3.chatter1.text: MARINE: Clear road marked. We are ready to take him into custody.
radio.m27.p3.chatter1.spoken: Clear road marked. We are ready to take him into custody.

radio.m27.p4.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.p4.beat.text: That's his jet. Teal's voice on his tapes. Bring him down.
radio.m27.p4.beat.spoken: That's his jet. Teal's voice on his tapes. Bring him down.

radio.m27.p5.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.p5.beat.text: SERA: Rusk is down. Follow three lights to Teal's broadcast line.
radio.m27.p5.beat.spoken: Rusk is down. Follow three lights to Teal's broadcast line.

radio.m27.p5.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.p5.chatter1.text: SERA: One more light. Above it, the whole coast can hear you.
radio.m27.p5.chatter1.spoken: One more light. Above it, the whole coast can hear you.

radio.m27.p6.beat.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.p6.beat.text: SERA: You're on every frequency. Say it your way.
radio.m27.p6.beat.spoken: You're on every frequency. Say it your way.

radio.m27.p6.chatter1.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.p6.chatter1.text: SERA: Last of his diehards. Keep them off the signal.
radio.m27.p6.chatter1.spoken: Last of his diehards. Keep them off the signal.

radio.m27.p6.chatter2.speaker: HARBOR
radio.m27.p6.chatter2.text: HARBOR: Loyalist pilots answering. Every harbor.

radio.m27.ace.stage1.speaker: RUSK
radio.m27.ace.stage1.text: RUSK: Every relay says I am the law. Yours is a child's radio. Wing!
radio.m27.ace.stage1.spoken: Every relay says I am the law. Yours is a child's radio. Wing!

radio.m27.ace.stage2.speaker: RUSK
radio.m27.ace.stage2.text: RUSK: Teal obeyed until the one order that mattered. Wing, finish him.
radio.m27.ace.stage2.spoken: Teal obeyed until the one order that mattered. Wing, finish him.

radio.m27.ace.return1.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.ace.return1.text: SERA: Rusk is turning back in. Here he comes.
radio.m27.ace.return1.spoken: Rusk is turning back in. Here he comes.

radio.m27.ace.return2.speaker: RUSK
radio.m27.ace.return2.text: RUSK: Then hear it from me. Head on.
radio.m27.ace.return2.spoken: Then hear it from me. Head on.

radio.m27.ace.call2.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.ace.call2.text: SERA: AIR MARSHAL RUSK pulled back to call his wing. 2 inbound.
radio.m27.ace.call2.spoken: Rusk pulled back to call his wing. Two inbound.

radio.m27.ace.call3.speaker: SERA
radio.m27.ace.call3.text: SERA: AIR MARSHAL RUSK pulled back to call his wing. 3 inbound.
radio.m27.ace.call3.spoken: Rusk pulled back to call his wing. Three inbound.
